why: In every row the bottle is shown in different positions: standing, tilted and lying. Row 2 already has a lying and a tilted bottle, so the missing one stands upright (all options do). The book picks option 2, whose balls are arranged like the tilted bottle in the middle of row 2 (white balls on top, black balls at the bottom).
trick: First fix the position (standing/lying/tilted) from the row, then compare the small details (ball colours).
note: The ball colours inside the small bottles are hard to read in the scan; the ball patterns are drawn approximately.
